description.value: Homalco Wildlife & Cultural Tours is a 100% Homalco First Nation-owned operation offering award-winning grizzly bear viewing, whale watching, and Indigenous cultural tours from Campbell River into Bute Inlet and the Discovery Islands. Guides weave ancestral knowledge, language, and marine expertise into every tour, connecting visitors to the traditional territory of the Xwémalhkwu people. A touring cyclist visiting the Campbell River area would find this a compelling half-day or full-day boat-based excursion into BC's coastal wilderness.

address.value: 1003 B Island Highway, Campbell River, BC
